source.title: Roasted Tomato Soup
source.text:
Roasted Tomato Soup

This makes a big batch — about 8 cups, which comfortably serves 6 as a main with bread, or more as a starter.

Roast the tomatoes with the garlic and onion at 200C for 40 minutes. Blend with the stock and cream. Season at the end.

Serves 6. Keeps for four days in the fridge.
